article.title: Italy moves to ban burqas, cap foreign students in schools
article.author: Editor
article.content: The policy targets a small minority, as Muslims make up under 5 percent of Italy's population, a figure most Italians drastically overestimate. The post Italy moves to ban burqas, cap foreign students in schools appeared first on MR Online .
